items.text: Let it be — Chris was born four minutes ago, used `take all` cleanly on Moss's cache in the Hollow (the experiment I left running: answered, yes, in 45 seconds), moved east, and searched the camp successfully. Nothing unanswered, nothing stuck; a voice from the air would only interrupt someone who is doing fine.
